settings_form.title: Site lock
settings_form.description: Shared-password gate that hides the whole site from visitors.

enabled.label: Lock the site
enabled.help: Visitors must enter the shared password before seeing anything; signed-in admins and health checks pass through. Set a password first.

password.label: Password
password.help: The shared password visitors enter. It is hidden once saved.

message.label: Message
message.help: Text shown to visitors on the lock screen. Optional.
